notes.title: New Update and Arms Race Pack DLC Available!
notes.content:
Greetings Drone Pilots, 

It’s been a while but it’s amazing to see so many of you enjoying Retrograde Arena! We’ve got some exciting new updates and another DLC for those of you who want to pay some $$$/¥¥¥ to us hard working devs!  

Check out the details below 

Update Log:

1. New Player Stats window 
Player and weapon stats so you can see who dominated with which weapon! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34884175/55aae8c64df9036ef382ccebd1d98a0d9560e745.png
2. Game mode Selection 
Game mode selection makes it easier to pick which type of match you want to be included in. Especially useful for the DLC owners wanting to play with those without the map packs! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34884175/d0a554909acf04031db27fad9af5293a59d7074c.png
3. New weapon: Hot War 
Schmexy new weapon for updated carnage.  


New Arms Race DLC Available! 
The DLC includes Arms Race game mode and six maps. 
https://i.imgur.com/0AATbNC.gif
Arms Race: Increase your level and upgrade your weapon by eliminating enemies. Win the match by being the first player to get a kill with the last weapon. There are UNLIMITED BULLETS for all weapons You'll respawn immediately after dying and get back to the action quick. A super-duper skill game mode that requires fast thinking and reflex. 


The DLC Includes: 

1. Arms Race game mode 
2. Arms Race maps: 

 Cross-Bounce: A claustrophobic map with short range and long-range battles. 
 Bouncy Barriers: Symmetrical map where no place is safe! 
 Inner Sanctum: Small map that will force Close Quarter Shootouts. 
 Asterisk Arena: Maps with a lot of shortcuts for unlimited play dynamics! 

3. Arms Race converted maps: 

 Prototype Arena 
 X Arena 



Extra Maps: 

1. King’s Crown map: 

 Museum: Arena that forces you to fight up close and personal to steal the crown.
 

2. Supersizer map: 

 Gladiator Arena: Different weapons, different strategy each round! 

 

FAQ 

1. What makes this different than deathmatch? 

 Unlimited bullets and you will change weapons after certain number of eliminations 

2. Why do the time limit change? 

 The time limit change according to the number of players in the match. 

3. My friends don't own the DLC, can they join this mode? 

 Anyone can join the mode as long as the game host own the Arms Race DLC 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1333400/Retrograde_Arena__Arms_Race_Pack/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1333741/Retrograde_Arena__Deathmatch_Pack/

Supersizer map: Cages: A map separated by mirrors forcing everyone to get up close and personal with the shotgun

notes.title: 🧿Retrogarde Arena out now in Early Access!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34884175/6f76e4b4da00f9b0160de4d5049eb3672d12982f.gif

Do you feel the vibe?

Our a stylish physics-based twin-stick shooter is out now in Early Access!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34884175/2cc83b708636252ac6d22c33dfd64ca545130adc.png

In Retrograde, weapons don't kill, but the environment does! Retrograde Arena completely reimagines the twin-stick formula with dynamic movement enhanced by weapon recoil.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34884175/b173c4aeb3e98a4ca20d7e7db80d30c6a1b37f3f.png

Guns aren’t just for attack, they are for speed, dodging, sharp corners, and brutal counter-attacks. Weapon recoil, bouncing beams, and environmental (deadly hazards) awareness make Retrograde Arena an entirely new kind of competitive multiplayer experience.

notes.title: Coming to Early Access May 28th!
notes.content:
🧠Play Smart, Play Chaos, Play Retrograde Arena!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34884175/560f31e570a2e72bfc7e23700e5d8c2e30190bab.png

Dripping with gorgeous neon and thrumming with powerful synth-wave tunes, Retrograde Arena captures 80’s vibes and puts players in various battles for dominance! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34884175/f68e743502e6805665321e5293305f1bd6b1a6a1.gif
FEATURES:

 A Multiplayer Chaos (Online & Local): Battle with up to 6 friends or AI in rapid-fire rounds of neon-drenched fury with retro-futuristic weapons. 
 Three Game Modes for Different Skill Types: 

    [olist]
 Last Man Standing for the quickest finger and deadliest shot.
     King's Crown for tactical ambush and intelligent skirmisher.
     SuperSizer for a new and intriguing game based around an insurmountable enemy.
[/olist]
 Physics Is The Key: Dominate Newton's laws and use your weapon’s recoil to dodge enemy attacks, smash them into walls, or fly around the arena at great speed.
 Grab Your Weapon: Use traditional weapons like machine guns, railguns, and shotguns to slam enemies to their doom! Or reflect enemy attacks back at them with the Mirror, unleash the dread Accelerator, or create a deadly black hole with the Imploder. 
 Conquer Every Arena: Each arena has its own layout and unique quirks that demand different strategies to succeed!
 Beauty Matters: Unlock different skins, thrusters, and particle effects to personalize your drone.
